verdict.rationale: Cekura provides a dedicated GitHub Actions CI/CD guide plus CLI/SDK and cron job automation for testing agents on each change, indicating CI integration is a first-class capability. However, the evidence pack only shows the guide's title/description, not concrete details on exit-code/gating behavior for deployments, and there is no independent corroboration of this specific workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of deployment-gating logic (pass/fail thresholds blocking merges/deploys), and independent/hands-on confirmation of the GitHub Actions integration.
